whatIs: CSS Layout Generator creates the code for a layout with CSS Grid or Flexbox. You start from a template (12 columns, 3 × 3, Holy Grail, sidebar, header-main-footer, infinite rows, or Flexbox row variants) and adjust rows, columns, fr sizes and gaps between cells.
At the end you copy the resulting CSS and HTML. It's a good fit for putting together a page structure without remembering all the grid syntax.
uses: Build the header, sidebar, content and footer skeleton of a dashboard.
Create a 3-column card grid with uniform gaps.
Learn how grid-template-columns and gap change as you move the controls.
caveats: It generates CSS and HTML, with no Tailwind output; if you use Tailwind you'll have to translate the classes.
The classes and structure are generic (for example .layout); rename them and check the responsive behavior, which is up to you.
It starts from predefined templates; for very specific layouts you'll have to tweak the CSS by hand.
pricingNote: Free to use, with no account and no paid plans.
idealFor: Anyone who wants the CSS for a Grid or Flexbox layout without writing it from scratch.
